reader_summary.headline: In this special celebratory episode.
reader_summary.overview: In this special celebratory episode, William Green spotlights some of the most important lessons from the greatest investor of all time: Warren Buffett. In honor of Buffett’s historic decision to retire after 60 years as Berkshire Hathaway’s CEO, William offers his thoughts on Buffett’s legacy & Berkshire’s future. IN THIS EPISODE YOU’LL LEARN: 00:00 - Intro 04:20 - What makes Berkshire Hathaway’s annual meeting a joyous experience.
